verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline dominant and a readable 'Enter Now' CTA, but the shoe is shrunk to a tiny icon crammed against the LIMITED badge and CTA in the top-right corner, and the body copy wraps into three cramped lines of near-illegible text. B is worse: the CTA and LIMITED badge are shrunk to unreadable specks under the shoe, so the call to action is effectively lost, and the body copy is jammed against the right edge with no margin.
